The pole is decorated with colorful ribbons (red, green, black/patterned) radiating outwards from a central wreath-like structure at the apex. Several hands and arms are visible holding the ribbons, suggesting dancers are present but mostly out of frame or obscured. The background features bare tree branches against a blue sky.
